basic_info.description: Nestled in the well-established and sunny Visitacion Valley neighborhood, this delightful 2-bedroom, 1-bath home offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and modern updates. Both generously sized bedrooms are filled with natural light, and laminate flooring flows throughout, providing a sophisticated look that is also easy to maintain. The updated kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring plenty of counter space and ample cabinetry, making it ideal for both everyday cooking and entertaining guests. The remodeled bathroom boasts a sleek LED-lit mirror and a premium TOTO toilet, adding a touch of luxury to this cozy home. Downstairs, the home offers a versatile bonus area that can be tailored to fit your needs. Outside, the low-maintenance backyard provides ample space for gardening, relaxing, or hosting outdoor gatherings. With its ideal location and stylish updates, this home presents an excellent opportunity to own a detached property in one of San Francisco's most up-and-coming neighborhoods.
